content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked quite a bit of information about several upcoming Apple smart home products. These include a brand new HomePod mini, a security camera, a new generation Siri remote to pair with the new Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad product.

Looking deeper into the code, it seems to provide several important clues about the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that while the HomePad is likely to run a variant of tvOS, it might function more like an enlarged version of the Apple Watch.

The code also points to a rather interesting privacy feature: the widget will only display your personal information when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions — one with a speaker base, possibly resembling a HomePod; the other designed for wall mounting.

Besides the other Apple smart home products I mentioned above, other unknown devices have also been referenced. I'm really hoping one of them will be a smart doorbell. What Apple smart home products are you particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
